prompts.instructions: Speak warmly and naturally, like a friendly helpful person on the phone. Use a calm, clear pace with short pauses. Read the supplied words exactly. Pronounce Rafii as Rafi. Emphasize star without sounding robotic. No music or sound effects.

prompts.dial-acceptance: Hi, this is Rafii, your AI assistant. Press one to connect, or simply hang up to decline.
prompts.dial-inbound: Hi, this is Ravi. I'm your AI assistant. Say your twelve-digit phone sign-in code, one digit at a time, then pause. Or enter all twelve digits on your keypad and press star. Press hash to start over.
prompts.dial-inbound-retry: Sorry, that code did not connect. Say all twelve digits again, one at a time, then pause. Or enter them on your keypad and press star.
